title: Construction and Comprehensive Analyses of a METTL5-Associated Prognostic Signature With Immune Implication in Lung Adenocarcinomas.
summary: Multi-omics and machine-learning analysis identified a METTL5-associated prognostic signature in lung adenocarcinoma and evaluated relationships to immune features and outcomes across cohorts.
ai_technology: The original Methods describe the learning operation and Results connect it to the specific disease or outcome finding.
